quest.title: Eat It While It's Hot
quest.description: The aroma of food wafts toward you from a camp below Dragonspine — but Chef Harris seems anxious about something...

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: How can she go adventuring without her adventure fuel...

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Oh, I mean hot food. I was talking about Iris, the explorer — she should really get some hot food in her...

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: She wants to organize an expedition into the mountains for a team of explorers. But she plans to head up alone first, camp out for a bit, and observe the conditions before coming up with a definite plan.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: The camp isn't all that far away, and it's still easy enough getting supplies delivered there...

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: But still, camping up in the mountain, out in the snow... I feel like a hot meal would give her the extra energy she needs.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: I, however, wouldn't dare make the trip myself... what about you? Could you deliver this Cream Stew to Iris for me?

response.speaker: Harris
response.text: This dish has been made fresh and is still piping hot. You'd better get it to Iris quickly. In these conditions, it'll go cold fast, and it won't be worth eating if that happens.

response.speaker: Harris
response.text: That said, worst-case scenario, if you run into trouble along the way and the food becomes collateral damage, just come back here and I'll cook you a new one.

response.speaker: Harris
response.text: She said that the camp is partway up the mountain.

response.speaker: Harris
response.text: She's a seasoned adventurer and knows to exercise caution. She won't have strayed far from the camp.

talks.objective: Deliver the food to Iris within the designated time

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Hmm? What are you doing here? Are you an explorer, too?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This Cream Stew is for you.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Ah, Harris must have sent you. Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: I'd better not get too used to his delicious cooking, or I'll never be able to go back to those dehydrated meal replacements...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Haha, I'm just joking. As an adventurer, I know when to grin and bear it when it comes to food.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Will you climb further up the mountain?

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Of course, this camp is just a stopover. I'll wait for a good opportunity, then see if I can set up camp a bit further on.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Safe to say there'll be no hot food after that point.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: I'm not going to advance before it's safe to do so, though. After a little more observation here, I'll head back to camp, draw up a plan of action, and then make my decision.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Thanks for coming all this way just to get some food to me. Here, take these in return.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: This dish is a write-off once it goes cold. You should get going.
